description: Declarative hook documentation — catalogs all hooks with event type, purpose, and configuration. The authoritative hook registration remains in hooks.json or settings.json; this file documents and describes the hooks.

hooks.name: prereq-check
hooks.purpose: Validates tool prerequisites (bash, python3, jq, git) and provides rich session context on startup including recovery hints, lifecycle detection, and anchor checks

hooks.name: intent-router
hooks.purpose: Detects project lifecycle state (virgin, discovered, planned, building, checkpoint, complete) and routes natural language user prompts to the appropriate VibeOS skill

hooks.name: secrets-scan
hooks.purpose: Scans file content for secret patterns (API keys, tokens, connection strings) and blocks writes containing secrets

hooks.name: frozen-files
hooks.purpose: Blocks edits to frozen files (CLAUDE.md, .env, and any files listed in frozen-files.json)

hooks.name: test-file-protection
hooks.purpose: Blocks implementation agents (backend, frontend, doc-writer) from modifying test files. Enforces TDD discipline: only tester and test-auditor agents may write tests

hooks.name: test-diff-audit
hooks.purpose: Detects test weakening — removal of assertions, deletion of test functions, addition of skip markers. Warns when test coverage decreases

hooks.name: worktree-scope-guard
hooks.purpose: Enforces exclusive path territories during parallel worktree execution. Reads .vibeos/worktree-scopes.json to prevent cross-branch file modifications

hooks.name: worktree-bash-guard
hooks.purpose: Blocks dangerous git and database operations in parallel worktree branches (no checkout main, no cross-branch merge, no force push, no destructive DB ops)

hooks.name: governance-guard
hooks.purpose: Blocks user prompts containing patterns that attempt to bypass quality gates, skip audits, disable hooks, or force unsafe operations

hooks.name: proof-protection
hooks.purpose: Blocks implementation agents from removing assertions in test files and from deleting evidence bundles

hooks.name: file-budget
hooks.purpose: Enforces per-file line budget — warns at FILE_BUDGET_WARN and blocks at FILE_BUDGET_MAX lines to keep files within size limits

hooks.name: gate-result-capture
hooks.purpose: Records completed Bash gate/test command outcomes to .vibeos hook-event evidence after tool execution. Capture-only: it does not claim to prevent completed tool effects.

hooks.name: validate-agent-return
hooks.purpose: Validates audit subagent return packets and blocks failed or critical/high audit returns before the primary agent continues.

hooks.name: state-flush-precompact
hooks.purpose: Flushes durable VibeOS hook-event state before context compaction.

hooks.name: state-flush-session-end
hooks.purpose: Flushes durable VibeOS hook-event state at session end.

hooks.name: limit-warning-capture
hooks.purpose: Captures Claude Code provider/session-limit notifications and writes reviewed one-shot local resume artifacts without blocking the notification event.

hooks.name: worktree-scope-setup
hooks.purpose: Creates Claude git worktrees and copies VibeOS worktree-scope state into the isolated checkout.

hooks.name: team-governance-task-created
hooks.purpose: Dormant-by-default agent-team governance hook. When enabled, requires created tasks to cite their governing WO and include a scoped description.

hooks.name: team-governance-task-completed
hooks.purpose: Dormant-by-default agent-team governance hook. When enabled, prevents team task completion without a governing WO reference.

hooks.name: team-governance-teammate-idle
hooks.purpose: Dormant-by-default agent-team governance hook that records enabled teammate idle events for pilot evidence.

hooks.name: model-policy-guard
hooks.purpose: Blocks model and effort downgrades for active model-policy tiers that do not allow downgrades. Observes policy_settings only because Claude Code does not allow those changes to be blocked.

hooks.name: response-quality-stop-review
hooks.purpose: Deterministically inspects the most recent assistant response and blocks only on concrete stub, placeholder, incomplete-code, or swallowed-error markers. No-ops on non-code turns

hooks.name: lane-loop-stop
hooks.purpose: Enforces bounded lane loops from active WO frontmatter. Verifies loop_goal only from captured gate/test evidence and records STALLED_AT_CEILING in session state when the turn ceiling is reached.
